name: React-to-opt
depthRule: Three levels only: lv1 = element of the selected scene, lv2 = branch, lv3 = the parameter that receives the modulation. Grouping is the 'group' field of each lv3 entry, rendered as a heading inside the lv3 column. Picker columns = Scene | Element | Branch | Parameter.
membershipRule: Only entries that CAN be modulated by audio exist here. A property that cannot receive a modulation is not listed at all: it lives exclusively in the panel that owns it (Appearance, Grid, Export). Hiding it removes noise from the picker.
ownershipRule: This file owns per-element audio modulation only. Scene flow, scene timing and transitions live in Scenes-opt.json.

rules.uniquePath: One modulator per exact lv1/lv2/lv3 path. Different paths on the same element are allowed.
rules.audioCeiling: The value set in the panel is the CEILING: audio drives the parameter from 0 to that value, never beyond.
rules.audioEasing: Every modulated parameter owns its easing (attack, release, curve), set in the panel that owns the parameter.
rules.noiseScope: Noise is a shape-level field that randomizes the cells. It is not a texture over the shape and does not modify the drawing.
rules.noiseLoop: Proportional loop on stretch, seamless, responsive to the current columns/rows. One noise per shape.
rules.cellPicker: A cell target is picked on the canvas, never from a list.
rules.effectLevel: A lv3 entry of kind 'effect' is the effect itself. Its parameters are not a fourth picker level: they open in the effect panel (Noise), where each one declares its own modulation slot.

lv1.label: Shape
lv1.desc: A glyph layer of the selected scene. The only element that owns Effects.

lv3.label: Offset X
lv3.desc: Horizontal position of the shape in the scene.

lv3.label: Offset Y
lv3.desc: Vertical position of the shape in the scene.

lv3.label: Scale
lv3.desc: Uniform scale of the shape.

lv3.label: Rotation
lv3.desc: Rotation of the shape around its centre.

lv3.label: Opacity
lv3.desc: Opacity of the whole shape.

lv3.label: Cell scale
lv3.desc: Scale of every cell of the shape, around its own centre.

lv3.label: Corner radius
lv3.desc: Corner radius of the cells. Keeps the merge between neighbours.

lv3.label: Cell padding
lv3.desc: Space around each cell inside the shape.

lv3.label: Cell gap
lv3.desc: Gap between adjacent cells.

lv3.label: Cell density
lv3.desc: How many cells of the shape stay filled.

lv2.label: Effects
lv2.desc: Effects applied to the shape. Only Noise in this version.

lv3.label: Noise
lv3.desc: Audio-driven field that randomizes the cells of this shape. Each filled cell samples its own quadrant and varies scale, offset, opacity and animation speed. It does not move the cell out of its quadrant and does not overwrite the drawing.

params.label: Preset
params.desc: Starting recipe of the field: Blobs, Stripes, Grain, Duotone, Composite.

params.label: Scale
params.desc: Size of the field features relative to the shape.

params.label: Detail
params.desc: Number of impulses summed: 1 = smooth blobs, 8 = dense texture.

params.label: Roughness
params.desc: Threshold that cuts the field: low = soft blobs, high = hard grain.

params.label: Distortion
params.desc: Jitter of the direction vector: warps and smears the features.

params.label: Direction
params.desc: Direction of the impulses, in degrees.

params.label: Aniso
params.desc: Anisotropy: 0 = round features, 1-2 = stretched along the direction.

params.label: Bandwidth
params.desc: Width of each impulse (0.5, 1, 2, 4).

params.label: Impulses
params.desc: How many impulses are summed (1, 2, 4, 8).

params.label: Less than
params.desc: Lower cut: values below stay untouched.

params.label: More than
params.desc: Upper cut: values above clamp to the maximum variation.

params.label: Cell scale
params.desc: How much of the field value becomes cell scale variation.

params.label: Cell offset
params.desc: How much of the field value becomes cell offset variation.

params.label: Cell opacity
params.desc: How much of the field value becomes cell opacity variation.

params.label: Cell speed
params.desc: How much of the field value becomes cell animation speed variation.

params.label: Speed
params.desc: Speed of the field evolution over time.

params.label: Seed
params.desc: Deterministic seed of the field.

params.label: Loop proportional
params.desc: Keeps the loop proportional when the shape is stretched.

params.label: Seamless loop
params.desc: Tiles the field with no visible seam.

params.label: Responsive to grid
params.desc: Re-tiles the field to the current columns/rows.

audioModulation.slot: Every param with modulatable: true takes one slot: source, amount (ceiling = the panel value), easing (attack, release, curve).

lv1.label: Group
lv1.desc: A group of layers of the selected scene. No Effects in this version.

lv3.label: Offset X
lv3.desc: Horizontal position of the group.

lv3.label: Offset Y
lv3.desc: Vertical position of the group.

lv3.label: Scale
lv3.desc: Scale of the group.

lv3.label: Rotation
lv3.desc: Rotation of the group.

lv3.label: Opacity
lv3.desc: Opacity of the whole group.

lv1.label: Cell
lv1.desc: A single cell of a shape, picked on the canvas.

lv2.label: Transform
lv2.desc: Motion of this cell inside its own quadrant.

lv3.label: Offset X
lv3.desc: Horizontal offset of the cell inside its quadrant.

lv3.label: Offset Y
lv3.desc: Vertical offset of the cell inside its quadrant.

lv3.label: Scale
lv3.desc: Scale of the cell around its own centre, position unchanged.

lv3.label: Rotation
lv3.desc: Rotation of the cell around its own centre.

lv3.label: Opacity
lv3.desc: Opacity of this cell.

lv3.label: Corner radius
lv3.desc: Corner radius of this cell; the merge with neighbours follows it.
